style: warm outlined cartoon with flat colors and soft shading

unifiedCanvas.framing: All layers share one origin. Full scenes scale the complete canvas from the feet anchor; compact scenes and HUD portraits crop the same canvas from anatomical anchors.

layers.body: 512x512 portrait or 512x768 full-body cells sharing the same origin as every other active layer
layers.head: unified-canvas six-column by two-row atlases selected by centralized skin token
layers.hair: separate unified-canvas back and front atlases; ears are painted in the head layer between them
layers.portraitShoulders: dedicated male/female transparent bust layers share the full-body hoodie style and fixed center neckline
layers.face: painted into each head cell so the face, ears, jaw, and neck share one illustration style and skin palette

replacementRules.locations: Keep portrait 9:16 framing and the same filename.
replacementRules.characters: Keep a transparent canvas, full body centered, and the same filename.
replacementRules.atlases: Head atlases must keep six centered ethnicity columns and male/female rows. Hair must keep six isolated 1:2 source cells. Run npm run assets:normalize-avatar, then npm run assets:build-avatar after replacing source art.
